issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (see notes: "calculateTotalPrice method: This method uses the shared stock to calculate the cost of a meal" and the listed items that must be static), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)). This mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about whether the method should be declared static and may lead to inconsistent implementations or grading issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and implementation consistent. Either update the solution to declare calculateTotalPrice as static (e.g., public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and adjust any callers accordingly) to match the problem statement, or revise the problem statement to not require calculateTotalPrice to be static if an instance method is intended.
